sentences.text:
----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan 2. Gotam S/o Rang Ji, R/o Bhamrvod Kherlipada, Ghatol,
 Banswara, Rajasthan.

For Respondent(s) : Mr.Vikram Sharma, PP  Mr.Vijay Kumar, Adv.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/08/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.43/2023, Police Station Ghatol, Distt.
Banswara for the offence under Sections 376(2)(ch) of IPC and Section 3/4(2)(ch), 5(dh)/6 of POCSO Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the victim has not levelled any allegation against the petitioner in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. Challan of the case has been presented and no investigation is pending.
The petitioner is in judicial lock up and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.

Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.
[2023:RJ-JD:26257] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-10208/2023] I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

sentences.text: Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case so also the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Suka @ Chaggan S/o Rang Ji shall be enlarged on bail in FIR No.43/2023, Police Station Ghatol, Distt. Banswara provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 175-NK/-
